The duties and responsibilities for a IT Project Manager (NETWORK/INFOSEC) GS-2210-13 generally include, but are not limited to, the following: Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, reliability, resiliency, operational readiness, and service dependencies; resolve complex operational issues.

Coordinate with budget, acquisition, contracting, program, and technical personnel to ensure effective management of IT resources. Develop network project plans, technical requirements, implementation strategies, schedules, milestones, and resource requirements.

Provide technical recommendations to contracting officials regarding contract administration, modifications, deliverable acceptance, schedule changes, and performance issues. Lead cross-functional teams of technical staff, program officials, contractors, vendors, and internal/external stakeholders.
To qualify for the position of IT Project Manager (NETWORK/INFOSEC), at GS-2210-13, you must meet the basic qualification requirements listed below. Basic Qualifications (2210 series): Please refer to the OPM IT Management Series 2210 Qualification Standard for the specific experience requirements for the GS-12 and above positions.

AND Specialized Experience: To qualify for the GS-13 grade level, you must have one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-12 grade level in the Federal service, or comparable non-Federal experience.

Specialized experience is defined as experience performing the following duties: Participate in the planning execution and monitoring enterprise IT projects involving network services, information security, and/or telecommunications. You MUST meet all qualification requirements by the 09/04/2026 of this announcement.

Your resume must support your responses to the application questionnaire and the qualification requirements. Failure to do so may result in an ineligible rating. See the Required Documents section for important notes about what must be included in your resume.

After you submit this application, you will receive an e-mail informing you that a USA Hire assessment is required of you. You will have 48 hours from the closing date of this announcement 09/04/2026 to complete the assessment as this assessment is part of your application.

The United States Space Force (USSF) at Los Angles AFB, El Segundo, CA is searching for an Acquisition Program Manager to support GPS Gen4 Space (NH-1101-03, GS 12/13 equivalent).

Description: If selected, you will serve as the Chief for GPS Gen4 Space, Gen4 Space Acquisition Strategy lead, and backup program management support for all GPS Gen4 contracts.

You will join a dynamic leadership team in System Delta 831 (SYD 831), providing national security Positioning, Navigation, and Timing services to our nation and allied partners, and working to build the next generation of GPS architecture from the ground up.

This specific role requires strong leadership skills, astute attention to detail, creative problem solving, and a collaborative motivation to achieve mission success across a diverse, geographically separated stakeholder team.

You must be able to work independently, planning, organizing and coordinating programmatic actions across various engineering, financial, legal, security, public affairs and contracting offices, both internal and external to Space Systems Command (SSC), USSF.

Strong communication skills are critical, both oral and written, with a focus on clear, concise and technically accurate dialogue that synchronizes efforts across more than 30 government and contractor organizations.

In addition, the duties of this position require the ability to analyze, negotiate, and resolve complex issues while maintaining good working relationships.

Finally, as part of our government team, you are expected to assist in the training, development, mentorship, and motivation of junior civilian and military program managers as they join the team.

Ideal Candidate: Experience with Government Space acquisitions, with government acquisition program offices, and contracts for military space segments; minimum program management practitioner (level 2) DIAWIA certification; minimum bachelor's degree, preferred master's degree.

Independent execution; Leadership; Briefing/clear, concise communication; Critical Thinking; Organization and Planning; Collaboration; Attention to Detail; Team Building. Key Skills and Abilities: 1.

Comprehensive knowledge of the applicable principles, concepts, policies, and laws; functions, programs, and systems applicable to the duties of logistics contracts and program management and material support; sources, responsibilities, and means for providing assistance and advice to resolve logistics contracts and program management problems; and all aspects of logistics contracts and program management support. 2.

Comprehensive knowledge of government and private industry policies and practices related to business management, industrial management, financial systems, technical concepts, and production practices.

Ability to gather, analyze, and evaluate a variety of program information, such as commercial business practices, market conditions, offer acceptability, contractor acceptability, contractor responsibility and/or performance to determine acquisition strategy and sources. 3.

Knowledge of the missions, roles, functions, organizational structures, and operation of the Department of Defense, and entities that govern, interface with, and/or influence management control of proposed and ongoing service contracts. 4.

Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, clearly, concisely, with technical accuracy and to use computers and a variety of software programs and databases, gather and analyze a variety of program information, make sound judgments concerning program progress, and effectively communicate recommendations orally and in writing to higher organizational management and contractors. 5.

Ability to establish and maintain good relationships with individuals and groups within the office as well as outside the immediate work unit and to be persuasive in representing the best interests of the government when dealing with personnel with highly divergent points of view. 6.

Ability to plan, organize, analyze problems, translate complex information, make appropriate judgments, evaluate options, conduct research, summarize results, make appropriate recommendations, and manage critical aspects of service contract requirements as related to the assigned functional area and meet deadlines.

Ability to compose and edit contract required correspondence, review and analyze directives, develop and brief service contract program related presentations.
The 1101 series does not have an individual occupational requirement that must be met. You can view the experience level requirements here. Please scroll down to the 3rd section titled Administrative and Management Positions.

The position serves as a Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Program Manager and specialist for all BARD patron-facing products in the Patron Engagement Section (PES), Patron and Network Engagement Division, National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS), Library Collections and Services Group.

As the Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Program Manager and specialist, you will: Serve as the subject matter expert in the development, implementation, and distribution of all versions of the product.

Review and analyze all BARD patron-facing products to ensure continuity in operation, consistency in delivery, high-level of accessibility, and that all patron considerations have been met. Coordinate all patron-facing customer service and technical support for all BARD products.

This includes BARD on the web, BARD Mobile for iOS, BARD Mobile for Android, BARD Mobile for Fire Devices, BARD Express, Digital Advanced (DA2) Talking Book machine, and the My Talking Book Skill. Serve as the primary liaison between the various BARD initiatives, NLS patrons, and other NLS stakeholders. Perform other duties as assigned.

At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?
We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated.

This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.
Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.
Learn about our Product & Tech team!
Deine Position
We are looking for a dynamic, highly organized, and proactive Technical Project Manager for Heartbeat AI to coordinate our operational flows and drive the day-to-day alignment across our 1K5° Energy Management System (EMS) teams.
In this role you will work directly with our Director of Engineering 1K5° EMS to ensure our executions runs smoothly and predictably. While our individual Product Managers focus on the feature definitions, you will be making sure that cross-team dependencies are clear, timelines are mapped out accurately, and everyone has what they need to deliver in time. You will bring teams together to solve operational bottlenecks, helping us scale Heartbeat AI fast and efficient.
Set up and run a continuous operational sync across the 1K5° EMS domain, ensuring that surrounding teams stay connected and share clear ownership of cross-team topics
Keep a close eye on technical and operational timelines across different engineering tracks, highlighting potential bottlenecks and resolving blockers before they impact key milestones
Maintain a clear view of project progress, helping to communicate deadlines and delivery risks accurately back to the wider leadership
Link our individual stakeholders, product managers, and engineers to streamline day-to-day operations and quickly resolve operational issues
Continuously find ways to improve how we track our progress, using automated reporting structures or dashboards to keep our roadmap visible, simple, and up to date
Dein Profil
You have completed a relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably with a focus on the tech or engineering domain or a comparable field
You have 2–3 years of professional experience in technical project management, IT project planning, consulting, or an operational role within a fast-paced tech environment
You understand how software engineering and product teams work together, making it easy for you to read technical requirements and follow engineering development cycles
You are highly organized and comfortable working with modern agile project management, documentation, and roadmap tools (such as Linear, Notion, or equivalent)
You bring a highly proactive, outcome-oriented hands-on mentality. You enjoy taking complex or unclear operational challenges, turning them into clean workflows, and driving them forward independently
You are an excellent communicator and a skilled moderator. You know how to balance diplomacy with assertiveness, allowing you to align different teams smoothly while keeping everyone accountable to project timelines
Interest or prior experience in the climate tech, IoT, or renewable energy industries

You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

CodeWrights entwickelt individuelle Softwarelösungen für einige der weltweit führenden Industrieunternehmen. Als Spezialist für industrielle Software, Geräteintegration und digitale Produktentwicklung unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, komplexe technische Herausforderungen erfolgreich zu lösen.
Du sorgst dafür, dass anspruchsvolle Software- und Entwicklungsprojekte zielgerichtet, transparent und verlässlich durch die Organisation geführt werden. Dabei koordinierst du Anforderungen, Ressourcen, Termine, Risiken und die Kommunikation zwischen allen Beteiligten und stellst sicher, dass Teams effizient zusammenarbeiten und gemeinsam optimale Lösungen für unsere Kunden entwickeln.
In deiner Rolle bist du weit mehr als klassischer PM: Du navigierst durch komplexe technische und organisatorische Zusammenhänge, moderierst Entscheidungen, schaffst Transparenz und verbindest Kunden, Entwicklungsteams und Stakeholder zu einem leistungsfähigen Projektumfeld. Dabei behältst du sowohl die Kundenanforderungen als auch wirtschaftliche Ziele und die Dynamik im Team im Blick.
Wir sind eine Expertenorganisation mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und einem modernen Dynamic-Work-Ansatz. Zusammenarbeit, Transparenz und Verantwortung dort, wo die Kompetenz liegt, prägen unsere Arbeitsweise.
Die Tür steht dir offen, wenn du Mut, Disziplin und die Fähigkeit mitbringst, anspruchsvolle Projekte erfolgreich zum Abschluss zu führen. Du verfügst über fundiertes technisches Verständnis und Projektmanagement-Erfahrung und gehst Themen nicht nur organisatorisch, sondern auch fachlich in der Tiefe an.

Idealerweise hast du einen Hintergrund in der Softwareentwicklung, Elektrotechnik oder einem ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Umfeld und dich gezielt in Richtung Projektmanagement weiterentwickelt. Mit deiner starken Kommunikationsfähigkeit verbindest du Menschen, schaffst Vertrauen und führst Projekte erfolgreich zum Ziel.
Die Position ist an unserem Standort in Karlsruhe angesiedelt.
Aufgaben

Teamkultur: Ein ambitioniertes Team, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedbackkultur auf Augenhöhe.

You will be managing the projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (Silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the APAC region

Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
Assisting in the development of project statements of work
Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
Managing project risk mitigation and plans
Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
Maintaining daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
Identify custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
Advocating for the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects

s.t:
Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments

s.h: PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred

Working closely with the Associate General Manager, Product Managers, Curriculum Specialists, Editorial, Design, Video, Marketing, and Sales, this role manages the planning, coordination, execution, and tracking of projects from concept through launch.
The Project Manager develops and maintains project schedules, coordinates cross-functional teams, manages resources and timelines, identifies risks, and ensures deliverables remain on schedule and within scope. Project Planning & Execution
Develop comprehensive project plans, timelines, milestones, and resource allocations for curriculum and ancillary product development.
Manage multiple concurrent curriculum projects across K–12 and supporting product lines.
Coordinate project schedules across internal and external teams.
Monitor project progress and proactively identify schedule risks, resource constraints, and dependencies.
Facilitate timely decision-making by escalating issues and recommending solutions when necessary.
Ensure projects remain on schedule, within scope, and aligned with organizational priorities.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Serve as a central communication hub for project teams and stakeholders.
Coordinate project meetings, agendas, follow-up items, and action plans.
Maintain clear communication regarding project status, milestones, risks, and upcoming deadlines.
Work closely with Product Managers to translate product vision into executable project plans.
Coordinate the work of internal and external teams throughout the product lifecycle.
Resource & Workflow Management
Develop and maintain long-range production schedules across multiple curriculum programs and grade levels.
Coordinate internal and external resources to maximize efficiency and balance workloads.
Maintain project management systems, dashboards, and documentation.
Monitor project capacity and recommend resource adjustments to meet organizational priorities.
Support contractor onboarding and scheduling as needed.
Manage contract requests and implementations with external contractors and vendors, as needed.
Product Documentation & Quality
Develop and maintain project documentation, including schedules, workflows, product specifications, meeting notes, and checklists.
Coordinate quality assurance checkpoints throughout curriculum development.
Ensure project documentation is accurate, organized, and accessible to stakeholders.
Support smooth transitions between curriculum development, editorial, production, and product launch.
Reporting
Assist Product Managers and leadership in developing processes for project budgets and production estimates.
Track project expenditures and resource utilization.
Develop project dashboards and status reports for leadership.
Collect and analyze project metrics to improve forecasting, scheduling accuracy, and team performance.
Process Improvement
Evaluate project management workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, communication, and scalability.
Develop standardized templates, processes, and best practices for curriculum development projects.
Support the implementation of new project management tools and technologies.
Promote continuous improvement across the Schools Team.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Education, Operations, or related field.
2+ years of project management experience, preferably in educational publishing, curriculum development, media production, or product development.
PMP or Project Management Certification desired.
Demonstrated experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.
Ability to drive a project forward with a servant-leader attitude: excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills.
Experience working with project management software (Smartsheet, Monday.com, Asana, Microsoft Project, or similar).
Exceptional ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage competing priorities.

## Description de l'emploi ##
Afin de soutenir le secteur des améliorations structurelles de la Direction de l-agriculture, de la viticulture et des améliorations foncières (DAGRI), nous sommes à la recherche d-un·e chargé·e de projets.
Les améliorations foncières dans le canton de Vaud visent à améliorer les conditions de vie et la situation économique du monde rural, notamment dans les régions de montagne et les régions périphériques. Elles regroupent des mesures d-aménagement, de construction et de réorganisation de la propriété foncière, au service de la production agricole et dans le respect des ressources.
Au sein de la DAGRI, vous contribuez à garantir la qualité, la conformité et la pérennité des projets d-améliorations structurelles, tout en participant à l-évolution des pratiques et des outils du secteur. Vous intervenez à la croisée du suivi de projets, du contrôle, de l-analyse et du conseil, en collaboration avec les équipes de la DAGRI, les autorités et les différents partenaires impliqués dans les projets.
Votre expertise permet ainsi de structurer les processus, sécuriser les investissements publics et accompagner les porteurs·euses de projets dans la réalisation de leurs ouvrages, tout en contribuant à l-évolution du cadre réglementaire et des pratiques du secteur.
## Responsabilités ##
* Concevoir et mettre en place un système de contrôle interne du secteur des améliorations structurelles, en veillant au respect des bases légales, directives et procédures applicables ainsi que contribuer à l-intégration des procédures et processus du secteur dans le futur système d-information des subventions (SIS).
* Concevoir et mettre en œuvre le dispositif de contrôle des projets subventionnés de manière à garantir la conformité des ouvrages réalisés aux décisions de subvention, leur utilisation conformément à l-affectation prévue et le respect des obligations d-entretien.
* Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser la documentation technique du secteur afin de rendre les exigences et les obligations claires et accessibles aux porteurs·euses de projets.
* Contribuer à la modernisation du cadre légal et réglementaire des améliorations foncières, notamment par l-analyse du dispositif existant, des études comparatives et la formulation de propositions d-évolution, en collaboration avec l-unité juridique.
* Conseiller et accompagner les entités publiques et privées, mandants et maîtres d-ouvrage, dans la conception, la planification, la mise en œuvre et le suivi de leurs projets d-améliorations foncières, notamment sur les aspects techniques, administratifs, juridiques et financiers.

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?
Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?
Then Pennylane is the right place for you !
Our vision
We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).
We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.
Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

s.h: In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to
s.t:
💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants
💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor .
🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe
🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings
🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!
Why this role exists
Pennylane is one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, building the financial operating system for SMBs and their accountants. Growth at our pace creates a constant stream of high-stakes, cross-functional initiatives that don't sit neatly inside any one team such as entering new markets, redesigning pricing, launching e-invoicing ahead of regulation.
This role owns those initiatives. You'll work directly with the VP Strategic Initiatives (and, through him, the executive committee) to take our most important initiatives from a blank page to a shipped outcome. It's a rare seat: broad exposure to how a scale-up actually makes its biggest decisions, real ownership from day one, and the kind of scope that builds a strong foundation for an operating role over time.
What you'll own
You'll lead selected priority initiatives end-to-end. For each, that means:
Framing the problem. Turn an ambiguous executive ambition into a structured plan: the hypothesis, the analysis that tests it, the milestones, and the definition of success.
Driving the work. Coordinate the product, commercial, finance, and ops teams needed to deliver. You're the person who makes sure it actually ships, on time and to the bar.
Doing the analysis yourself. Build the models, pull the data, and pressure-test the numbers that decisions rest on. You won't delegate the thinking.
Keeping the ExCo close. Report progress, risks, and recommendations crisply and often. When something is off track, they hear it from you first, with a proposed path forward.
Some initiatives you'll run start to finish. On others you'll be the extra set of hands on whatever matters most that quarter. Both require someone who's comfortable being handed a hard, undefined problem and trusted to figure it out.

5–10 years in top-tier management consulting and/or a VC-backed scale-up, with a track record of owning complex projects to completion in a fast-moving environment.
Exceptional analytical capabilities — you're fluent with data and models, and you use them to sharpen decisions, not decorate them.
Structured thinker and clear communicator who can make a complex trade-off legible to an executive audience in a page or a slide.
Genuinely comfortable with ambiguity: strong judgment, a bias to action, and the maturity to prioritize hard.
Fluent in French and English.
This is a role for a strategic thinker who likes to get their hands dirty. If that's you, we'd love to talk.
Recruitment process
Screening with Orane, Senior Business Recruiter (30 min)
Interview with Eric, VP Strategic Initiatives (1h)
Take-home business case, presented live (1h)
Final interview with a founder (45 min)

s.t:

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

At CustomMade , we believe engagement rings should be as personal as the relationships they represent. We make it easy to create a ring that’s both one-of-a-kind and affordable. Turns out people really like that and word is really spreading quickly! We’ve created 30,000 pieces of custom jewelry and helped 12,000 couples get engaged, but we’re still just getting started reshaping the jewelry industry.
As our business continues to grow, we are looking for additional Custom Jewelry Project Managers to join our team of around 50.

Our offering is built on a one-on-one, specialized, and custom design experience and service. You’ll be the face of our company to the customer, coordinating with our designers, gem experts, and production specialists to help design and create their dream ring.
In this role, you’ll be evaluated primarily on your ability to connect with customers, coordinate design and gem selection, and effectively execute the customer’s design vision. Each project you handle will be unique and require creativity, discretion, and independent judgment. Our customers are at the heart of our process and, as a Custom Jewelry Project Manager, you’ll be an integral part of both their success and ours.

Vorweg, damit wir uns die Zeit sparen: Wir suchen keine Person, die Tickets von links nach rechts schiebt. Wir suchen jemanden, der einem Kunden auch mal widerspricht – mit guten Argumenten und Zahlen im Rücken.
Wenn du beim Wort „Freigabeprozess" innerlich aufatmest, wird das hier nichts. Wenn du beim Wort „Business Value" schon eine Rückfrage im Kopf hast: lies weiter.
Wer wir sind
creativestyle ist eine E-Commerce-Agentur mit deutsch-polnischem Setup: Projektmanagement in München, Entwicklung in Krakau und Rybnik. Über 120 umgesetzte Shops, rund 110 Leute, Kunden wie benuta, NKD, BRAX, CEWE Fotobuch, Einhell, Rieker und Bergzeit.

Jede und jeder bei uns hat einen technischen Background. Die Geschäftsführung eingeschlossen.
50% Freiheit, 50% Verantwortung. Beides gilt gleichzeitig.
Fehler sind bei uns Lektionen, keine Schuldfrage. Wir steigen nur ungern zweimal in denselben Fluss.
Corporate sind wir nicht. Unzuverlässig allerdings auch nicht – und falls du glaubst, dass sich das ausschließt, beweisen wir dir gern das Gegenteil.
Wir nehmen keine Projekte an, auf die wir keine Lust haben. Aufgeräumt wird hier nur, was wir selbst angefangen haben.
Warum wir diese Stelle gerade jetzt besetzen

1. Wir bauen unser PIM- und ERP-Geschäft aus. Ab nächstem Jahr bieten wir Pimcore und Odoo an. Wir suchen jemanden, der diese Projekte nicht nur steuert, sondern Kunden im Workshop schon den Unterschied zwischen sauberem Datenmodell und teurer Migration zeigt.
2. Wir erfinden die PM-Rolle neu: In Zeiten von KI reicht bloßes Tickets-Schreiben nicht mehr – wir sind Innovationstreiber, keine Werkbank! Bei uns geht es um messbaren Impact, echtes Produktdenken und KI-Innovationen. Du steigst also in eine Rolle ein, die du aktiv mitgestalten kannst.
Aufgaben
Deine Mission
Projekte führen – von Anfang bis Betrieb. Du verantwortest Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung großer E-Commerce-Projekte: Discovery, Konzept, Kickoff, Go-live und die Zeit danach. Technisch bewegen wir uns in Shopware, Adobe Commerce / Magento, commercetools, Pimcore und Storyblok.
Der Mensch sein, bei dem alles zusammenläuft. Du bist Hauptansprechpartner*in für unsere deutschsprachigen Kunden und die Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams in Polen. Kundenbedürfnisse übersetzt du in saubere Lösungen, die Ideen des Teams bringst du zurück zum Kunden.
Impact – und zwar messbar. Messbar meinen wir wörtlich: Zu jeder Initiative gehören ein KPI und ein Tracking-Konzept, mit dem sich Vorher und Nachher belegen lassen.
Denken wie ein Product Owner. Behandle das Produkt wie dein eigenes! Wenn dich eine Funktion, ein Design oder eine Priorisierung nicht überzeugt, sprichst du es offen an. Bei unklarem Business Value stoppst du die Umsetzung, bis Klarheit herrscht. Die finale Entscheidung trifft der Kunde, klar – aber blind umgesetzt wird bei uns nichts.
Und der ganz normale Rest. Projektpläne, Timings, Budgets und Status-Reports hältst du zuverlässig auf Kurs. Meetings, Workshops, Sprint-Plannings und Retros moderierst du so, dass hinterher alle wissen, was Sache ist. Risiken erkennst du, bevor sie eins werden.
Deine Spezialisierung: PIM oder ERP
Hier liegt der Unterschied zu einer klassischen PM-Stelle. Eins von beidem bringst du mit:
PIM (Pimcore) – Du weißt, wie Produktdaten wirklich aussehen, bevor sie schön sind: Datenmodelle, Attribute, Varianten, Kanäle, Übersetzungen. Du hast schon mal eine Migration aus einer gewachsenen Excel-Landschaft begleitet und danach trotzdem noch an das Projekt geglaubt.
ERP (Odoo) – Bestände, Preise, Aufträge, Rechnungen, Schnittstellen. Du kannst einschätzen, was ins ERP gehört, was in den Shop und was besser in keins von beidem.
Beides mitzubringen wäre Angeberei – wir hätten aber nichts dagegen.
Du kommst aus einer vergleichbaren Welt, nur mit anderen Systemen (Akeneo, Contentserv, SAP, Business Central)? Dann sprich uns trotzdem an. Uns interessiert, ob du die Zusammenhänge verstehst, nicht welches Logo auf dem Login-Screen war.
Qualifikation
Du bist unser Mensch, wenn
Du mindestens 3 Jahre Projekte im digitalen Umfeld oder im E-Commerce geführt hast – von der ersten Idee bis in den Betrieb.
Du technisch mitreden kannst: APIs, PIM, ERP, Schnittstellen. Selbst programmieren musst du nicht. Verstehen, worüber die Devs gerade streiten, schon.
Scrum und Kanban dein Handwerkszeug sind und du Jira, Confluence und Miro im Schlaf bedienst.
Du fließend Deutsch (C2) und sehr gut Englisch sprichst – unsere Kunden sitzen im DACH-Raum, unsere Teams in Polen.
Du zwischen den Zeilen liest und Bedürfnisse erkennst, bevor sie im Briefing stehen.
Du aus einem leeren Blatt eine Roadmap machst: Backlog, Milestones, Budget, Timing.
Du KI-Tools schon im Alltag nutzt – oder große Lust hast, das in den nächsten Monaten zu ändern.
Du auch dann noch weißt, was zu tun ist, wenn der Deadline morgen und das Problem heute ist.
Pluspunkte sammelst du mit Erfahrung auf Händlerseite und mit Shopware und/oder Magento.
Wir bauen ein offenes Team. Bewirb dich unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Orientierung, Religion oder Behinderung – uns interessiert, was du kannst und wie du denkst.

Was du bei uns bekommst
70.000 – 85.000 € , abhängig von Erfahrung und Spezialisierung. Konkrete Zahlen gibt es beim ersten Gespräch, nicht erst nach der dritten Runde.
Innovationsbudget für PoCs und eigene Ideen – bewusst als Investment gedacht, nicht als Restposten.
Weiterbildungsbudget inklusive Zertifizierungen (z. B. Shopware, Pimcore, …).
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office. Die Arbeit passt sich deinem Leben an, nicht umgekehrt.
Büro mit Dachterrasse im TRI München – plus MVV-Ticket, damit du auch hinkommst.
MacBook Pro und iPhone, ordentliche Peripherie inklusive.
Teamevents in Deutschland und Polen. Epische Trips nach Polen und die legendäre Revanche der polnischen Crew auf der Wiesn – eine Tradition mit Erfolgsgarantie!
Kaffee, Getränke und Obst. Muss man ja heute dazuschreiben.

## Our Team ##
Since the 2026 season, Audi has been competing in the FIA Formula 1 World Championship.
The new team has three locations. The Motorsport Competence Center of Audi in Neuburg (Germany) is considered one of the most modern of its kind in Europe. The Formula 1 factory of Audi Motorsport AG in Hinwil (Switzerland) is known for its innovative technologies and passion for racing. The Audi Motorsport Technology Center in UK is in its launch phase and growing continuously. Our Power Unit comes from Neuburg, while Hinwil is responsible for the development of the chassis and race operations.
What you need? The mindset of an athlete. If you are someone for whom giving up isn-t an option and limits are just something to be overcome, you can bring Vorsprung durch Technik to Formula 1 with us. Become part of this unique project and make motorsport history.
This position is to be filled at Audi Formula Racing GmbH in Neuburg (Germany).
In program management, we act as the central unit of Audi Formula Racing GmbH. We form the interface between the technical areas, the supply chain and the financial management of the company and are thus responsible for the complex project management for the development and production of the Audi F1 Powertrain.

We operate in a highly exciting, always time-critical and rapidly changing environment. Through intensive cooperation, we ensure transparency for the achievement of project goals and early identification of project risks. In addition to high personal standards, willingness to communicate and team performance, we also focus on enjoying our work!

Due to the dependence of many different topics in our area of responsibility, close cooperation and a high degree of openness are prerequisites for our successful work.

* Project planning and management: Responsibility for the planning, implementation and control of projects within the framework of Audi Formula 1 activities. Creation of transparency about development and supply chain processes for the Audi F1 Power Unit.
* Align and set milestones, goals, and timelines to ensure that all projects are on track to achieve overall goals.
* Cross-departmental coordination: Close cooperation with the project manager, the development teams of the Power Unit and the adjacent departments of logistics, procurement, quality assurance and workshops. Ensure a smooth flow between these teams to optimize the development cycles of the power unit components.
* Risk management: Identification of risks and proactive development of measures and proposed solutions so as not to jeopardize project results.
* Reporting: Regular reports to AFR management on the progress and status of projects.
* Continuous process optimization: Analyze and improve existing operations with a focus on program management and supply chain processes to continuously increase efficiency and performance.
* Progress monitoring and evaluation: Regularly reviewing project progress to ensure that strategic goals are being met and adjustments can be made in a timely manner if necessary.
## Your Profile ##
* Professional experience: Several years of experience in project management, preferably in the motorsport industry or in a comparably demanding environment with high dynamics and technical complexity.
* Technical understanding: A high level of understanding of the technical processes and requirements in the Formula 1 environment in order to be able to coordinate and control projects efficiently.
* Methodological skills: Sound knowledge of project management methods as well as in the areas of time and resource planning, risk management and cost control.
* Experience in project management of interdisciplinary teams and the motivation of employees in a dynamic environment.
* You have business fluency in German or English and are willing to learn basic knowledge of the other language.
* Resilience and flexibility: High resilience and the ability to deliver high-quality results under high pressure in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.
* Problem-solving skills: Strong ability to analyze complex problems and develop creative, pragmatic solutions.
* International experience: Willingness to travel as well as intercultural competence to operate effectively in a global environment.
